newsitem.title: UK: London gold fixes at near four-year low.
newsitem.headline: London gold fixes at near four-year low.

text.p: Gold was fixed at $340.90 per ounce on Friday to record its lowest fixing since April 22, 1993.
The fall continued a slide in prices stretching back to the beginning of the year. On Thurdsday it fixed at $342.80, a fresh low since September 14, 1993.

Market sentiment has been crumbling since the middle of last year on fears that international institutions such as the International Monetary Fund and the central banks could begin to sell gold from their reserves.
That concern has increased since the beginning of the year as the European central banks mull gold sales as a route towards meeting the financial criteria for joining European Monetary Union.
"I am more convinced than ever that central banks are in the market and selling," one senior dealer said.
"There has been selling also by despairing investors who bought gold years ago at much higher prices and are more and more certain these prices will not be seen again," the dealer added.
